Copilot Next Level Options

Option A — Real Test Runner (Jest-style)
- Add automated tests with pass/fail results
- Validate functions with real assertions
- Best for catching actual runtime bugs

Option B — Debug Mode Button
- Add a UI button inside your app
- Runs self-check functions on demand
- Shows console + UI logs of issues

Option C — Supabase Safe Testing Layer
- Tracks state changes before/after database updates
- Verifies Supabase responses match UI state
- Helps prevent data sync bugs
